description:
A Spotify artist by link/URI/ID: name, image and top tracks (~10) with durations and preview URLs.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id` OR `artist`.
Returns: id (string), link (string), name (string), image_url (string, nullable), top_tracks (array<object>), top_tracks_count (integer).

url.description: Artist link, URI or ID. Example: "https://open.spotify.com/artist/06HL4z0CvFAxyc27GXpf02"

name: spotify_artist
title: Spotify artist
